compiled_state.description: Add preconditions.inference_review.rate_rationale=20 and preconditions.inference_review.rate_high_stakes=100 to .claude/dso-config.conf. Integrate floor enforcement into the existing config-validation entry point (validate.sh gate or preconditions-validator-lib.sh, NOT a standalone script). Floor rule: rate_high_stakes must be >= 100; reject with non-zero exit and message referencing 'minimum floor 100' when value is below threshold. rate_rationale accepts 0-100 with no floor. Update plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md to document both keys in the same changeset (section: preconditions.inference_review.*). One-time install-time log entry for active defaults (log to stderr at config-load time when keys are absent and defaults are applied). Acceptance: all tests in test-config-inference-review-validator.sh pass.
